senses.gloss: f. (corresp. to a word καταβολία; cmp. κατάβλημα) a (leather) curtain, spread, cover.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:4">Kel. XVI, 4</cite> <he>ק׳</he> the hide spread over the bed-frame.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:17">Tosef. Sabb. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:17">IV</cite>), 17 <he>קיטבליא חדשה</he> (Var. <he>קטבליא</he>, <he>טבלה</he>) a new leather spread; Y. ib. VI, 8ᵃ <cite ref="S00737"><he>קטיבלייא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:11">Tosef. Ter. X, 11</cite> <he>קיטבילא</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="S00697"><he>קטבוליא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:1:24">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קטיב׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:5">Kel. XXVI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:6">6</cite>) <he>עור קטבוליא</he> Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. <he>קטבולין</he>) the hide which is used as a spread.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b:6">B. Mets. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>פרס לה קיטבליא ע״ג דישה</he> (Ms. M. <he>קטביל׳</he>; Ms. F. <cite ref="S01988"><he>קרטבליא</he></cite>) if he spread a leather cover over the grain to be threshed (preventing the ox from eating); a. e.—Pl. (fr. <cite ref="S00700"><he>קָטַבְלִי</he></cite> καταβολή) <he>קָטָבְלָאוֹת</he>, <he>קָטַבְלָיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:4">Shek. III, 4</cite> <he>מחפה בק׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>קיטבל׳</he>) he covered (last year’s contributions) with leather spreads. Y. ib. III, end, 47ᶜ <he>שמט את הקטבליו׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>הקטבליי׳</he>; Bab. ed. <he>קטבליאות</he>; Ms. M. <cite ref="S00893"><he>קיטבלאות</he></cite>) when the covers are removed; Tosef. ib. II, 4 <he>שמנו ק׳</he> (corr. acc.).
